import numpy as np
# constant-x edge, h=180 both frames: x_true = px + k*(x_z0-px), k=(1.55-z)/1.55
# obs_0149 px=2.950 x_z0=3.2065 ; obs_0152 px=2.200 x_z0=3.6310
a,xa=2.950,3.2065; b,xb=2.200,3.6310
k=(a-b)/((xb-b)-(xa-a))
z=1.55*(1-k); X=a+k*(xa-a); X2=b+k*(xb-b)
print('k=%.4f  z=%.3f  X=%.3f / %.3f'%(k,z,X,X2))
# y extents of that edge
for nm,py,y0,y1 in [('0149',7.4,5.760,5.052),('0152',7.4,5.819,4.920)]:
    print(nm,'y_true %.3f -> %.3f'%(py+k*(y0-py),py+k*(y1-py)))
# constant-v=349 line if same height
D0=1.55*256/93.0
print('v349 y_z0=%.3f  y_true(if z=%.2f)=%.3f'%(7.4-D0,z,7.4+k*(7.4-D0-7.4)))
EOF
